name: Handbook & Craft Opt
description: Enhances crafting and handbook usability with a searchable, paginated recipe browser, one-click crafting grid filling, bulk ingredient transfer, ingredient tooltips, grouped alternative-output recipe tiles with a small blue corner marker that rotate every 2 seconds and pause on hover, and a searchable mod guide browser. Clicking a visible variant loads that exact recipe through the native crafting grid and server validation. Preserves the vanilla Handbook and supports recipes from both vanilla and mods.
